terrain.algorithm: DEM averaged to configured terrain resolution; PySheds pit fill, depression fill, flat resolution, D8 flow direction and accumulation; HAND computed with the same flat-resolved DEM used for flow direction; HAND bilinearly and streams by nearest-neighbour resampled to map grid

flood.filter_formula: Lee in linear power: local mean + max((local variance - noise variance) / local variance, 0) * (pixel - local mean); noise variance is the 20th percentile of valid local variances. Invalid samples are excluded from normalized window statistics.
flood.confidence_formula: 0.40 * min(max(abs(z_vv), abs(z_vh)) / 6, 1) + 0.25 * same-sign-change + 0.20 * min(distance_to_invalid / 30 m, 1) + 0.15 * max(1 - slope / 35 degrees, 0), clipped component-wise to [0, 1].

provenance.normalization_method: Per-band median-ratio scale followed by median offset, fit to valid stable pixels (HAND > 100 m, slope <= 35 degrees) after excluding the 2% tails of each band's post-minus-pre change distribution.

zone_definitions.within_100m_of_streams: Euclidean distance <= 100 m from rasterized stream cells.
zone_definitions.near_stream_components: Valid post SCL 8-11 cells within 150 m of streams.
